research_window.note: Continuous scan from the prior accepted open-branch boundary. The New York City ruling was published within the exact window; four additional material filings or rulings first surfaced during this scan but predated the boundary and are explicitly treated as late-indexed discoveries. publication_authorization: The user authorizes maintenance branches, pull requests and merging after evidence, local acceptance and successful CI; repository policy still requires Phillip Linstrum’s final publication acceptance before merge.
